title: LZ Paper Map: literature on the 248 keV nuclear-recoil candidate

creators.name: Cyncynates, David
creators.affiliation: Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics

description:
A searchable, interactive literature map of papers responding to the LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV nuclear-recoil candidate announced on 1 September 2026. Papers are grouped by physical mechanism, with machine-assisted summaries, publication-date filtering, citation relationships, and links to the original preprints.

This archive contains the website source, reviewed paper catalogue, taxonomy, and reproducible layouts. The evolving map is available at https://davidcyncynates.github.io/lz-paper-map/. It is a literature-navigation aid, not a statement of scientific consensus.
